  - text: CLASS 9 · QUADRILATERAL PROOFS
  - heading "Conditions for a Quadrilateral to Be a Parallelogram" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Test different conditions. Any one valid condition is enough to prove a quadrilateral is a parallelogram.
  - text: 30 min Class 9 Geometry Interactive
  - navigation:
    - button "Interact"
    - button "Learn"
    - button "Example"
    - button "Formula"
    - button "Practice"
  - main:
    - heading "INTERACTIVE MODEL" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drag any vertex A, B, C, or D. Observe the conditions on the right.
    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - img "Draggable quadrilateral condition model": A B C D O
    - button "Vertex":
      - img
      - text: Vertex
    - button "⌁Diagonals"
    - button "✣Marks"
    - button "Grid":
      - img
      - text: Grid
    - text: Show measurements
    - switch "Show measurements" [checked]
    - img
    - text: Lock shape
    - switch "Lock shape"
    - article:
      - heading "CONDITIONS DASHBOARD" [level=2]
      - paragraph: A quadrilateral is a parallelogram if at least one condition is true.
      - button "1 Opposite sides are parallel AB ∥ CD and AD ∥ BC × Not satisfied":
        - text: 1 Opposite sides are parallel AB ∥ CD and AD ∥ BC
        - strong: × Not satisfied
      - button "2 Opposite sides are equal AB = CD and AD = BC × Not satisfied":
        - text: 2 Opposite sides are equal AB = CD and AD = BC
        - strong: × Not satisfied
      - button "3 Opposite angles are equal ∠A = ∠C and ∠B = ∠D × Not satisfied":
        - text: 3 Opposite angles are equal ∠A = ∠C and ∠B = ∠D
        - strong: × Not satisfied
      - button "4 Diagonals bisect each other AO = OC and BO = OD ✓ Satisfied":
        - text: 4 Diagonals bisect each other AO = OC and BO = OD
        - strong: ✓ Satisfied
      - button "5 One pair of opposite sides is equal and parallel AB = CD and AB ∥ CD × Not satisfied":
        - text: 5 One pair of opposite sides is equal and parallel AB = CD and AB ∥ CD
        - strong: × Not satisfied
      - text: "Result: 1 sufficient condition is satisfied."
      - strong: ∴ ABCD is a parallelogram.
    - article:
      - heading "LIVE MEASUREMENTS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: AB = 6.31 CD = 6.4 AD = 4.89 BC = 4.72
      - paragraph: AO = 3.75 OC = 3.66 BO = 4.15 OD = 4.34
    - article:
      - heading "ANGLE MEASUREMENTS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: ∠A = 97.81° ∠B = 83.01° ∠C = 98.47° ∠D = 80.71°
    - article:
      - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: If the diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other, then it has the properties of a parallelogram.
      - text: "Proof idea:"
      - paragraph: From AO = OC and BO = OD, triangles AOB and COD are congruent by SSS. Hence AB ∥ CD and AD ∥ BC.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: In quadrilateral PQRS, diagonals PR and QS bisect each other at O.
      - img
      - paragraph: "Given: PO = OR and QO = OS To prove: PQRS is a parallelogram."
      - text: "Conclusion: PQ ∥ SR and PS ∥ QR"
    - article:
      - heading "WARNING" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: WARNING
      - paragraph: Equal diagonals alone are NOT sufficient!
      - img
      - paragraph: In this isosceles trapezium, AC = BD but it is not a parallelogram.
